newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rotterdam bunkers firm $1, rest of Europe stable.
newsitem.headline: Rotterdam bunkers firm $1, rest of Europe stable.

text.p: Rotterdam bunker prices firmed again on Tuesday, while the rest of Europe was broadly stable, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 CST fuel oil bunkers were quoted at around $98/$99 fob as barges rose to around $96 ex wharf.
Most traders said the market was tight for product deliveries before August 10, although some suggested the tightness was more hyped than actual.
Total ARA bunker volumes remained low. High prices again acted as a discouragement.
Hamburg, which had risen steadily at the end of last week and on Monday was momentarily stable.
Mediterranean bunkers were broadly stable with a number of ports again seeing reasonably active business.
